name: dropdown-menu
title: DropdownMenu / DropdownMenuTrigger / DropdownMenuContent / DropdownMenuItem / DropdownMenuSeparator / DropdownMenuSub / DropdownMenuSubTrigger / DropdownMenuSubContent
author: wmzy <https://github.com/wmzy>
docs:
Click-triggered floating menu with `DropdownMenuTrigger`/`Content`/`Item`/`Separator` parts. Exports: `DropdownMenu`, `DropdownMenuTrigger`, `DropdownMenuContent`, `DropdownMenuItem`, `DropdownMenuSeparator`, `DropdownMenuSub`, `DropdownMenuSubTrigger`, `DropdownMenuSubContent`. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add wmzy/haze-ui/dropdown-menu ``` The wrapper lands at `components/ui/haze/dropdown-menu.tsx` (via the `@ui/` target placeholder from `components.json`) and re-exports the component(s) from the `haze-ui` npm package, which is installed automatically. ## Theming haze-ui ships JS and CSS separately — the installed wrapper already imports `haze-ui/css/tokens.css` and `haze-ui/css/dropdown-menu.css`, so no extra stylesheet setup is needed. Activate the design tokens by applying the classes to a root element: ```jsx import { lightTheme, spacing, typography } from 'haze-ui'; // on or any root container — darkTheme is a drop-in swap
…
``` Details: https://github.com/wmzy/haze-ui/tree/main/registry
